archPosition.unit: fraction from source SW road endpoint
archPosition.method: visual ratio along full longitudinal elevation2a-61, registered to OSM endpoint corridor; no georeferenced arch survey
archPosition.uncertainty: ±.05 of corridor (about±6.1m); old drawing/current placement tie-in pending

archSpringRelativeM.unit: m relative to bridge road endpoint height
archSpringRelativeM.method: semicircular clear span fixes radius3.05m; low arch spring and shallow slopes inferred from elevation and side photographs; neutral endpoint datum

archRingThicknessM.method: coarse ring-to-clear-span proportion in figure2a-61; not a measured structural section
archRingThicknessM.uncertainty: ±.25m; 1921 historical secondary report not used as field measurement

pavementThicknessM.method: thin asphalt deck above arch ring, for candidate geometry; material is reported, thickness is not

railHeightM.method: elevation rail-to-span and adult-height contextual proportion in street photograph; not calibrated imagery

railPostPitchM.method: coarse repeated railing interval in full elevation; candidate repetition, actual post count unknown

railPostWidthM.method: coarse line-weight/rail-width proportion; representative low-poly stone post

slopeProfile.value: smooth sine approaches to one crest over the arch
slopeProfile.method: preserves gradual asphalt slopes and exact endpoint heights; not a surveyed vertical alignment
slopeProfile.uncertainty: crest about2.35±.9m over neutral endpoints; road/collision height and current water datum pending

notes: Actual Blender export bound to hashes. Ground, collision, in-game appearance, day/night and performance remain unknown.

glbStats.scope: selected object meshes; bytes refer to whole shared GLB
